name: tpddb

relevance.justification: Directly covers core MyChem.info entity type (chemical/drug compounds). 28,655 targeted protein degraders (PROTACs, molecular glues, LYTACs, ATTECs, AUTACs, AUTOTACs) with SMILES, molecular formula, target UniProt IDs, bioactivity measurements (IC50, DC50, Dmax), and disease associations (ICD-11, OrphaID). All five BioThings relevance criteria met: structured tabular data, standard biomedical identifiers, drug-target relationships, actively maintained (last updated 2025-08-31).

novelty.justification: Targeted protein degrader (TPD)-specific activity data (DC50, Dmax, cell viability) is not present in any existing BioThings source. While PROTACs/molecular glues may appear in ChEMBL as compounds, the degrader-specific mechanism fields (Ligase identity, Subtype classification, TPD-specific activity metrics) are completely novel. 27,796 activity measurements across 201 cell lines with ICD-11 disease associations and PDB ternary complex IDs are not replicated elsewhere in BioThings.

openness.justification: CC BY-NC 4.0 license. Freely accessible bulk download, no login required. Non-commercial restriction is compatible with BioThings academic/research posture (Su Lab, Scripps Research is non-profit). Minor risk for downstream commercial API consumers.

evidence.scope: Targeted protein degraders (TPDs): PROTACs, molecular glues, LYTACs, ATTECs, AUTACs, AUTOTACs. Covers compound structures (SMILES), targets (UniProtKB), degrader-specific activity (IC50/DC50/Dmax), disease associations, PDB ternary complex structures.
evidence.overlap: Compound structures may overlap partially with ChEMBL/PubChem in MyChem.info, but TPD-specific activity data (DC50, Dmax, Ligase, degrader Subtype) is novel. No existing BioThings source covers the TPD modality specifically.

api_info.notes: No public REST API. /api endpoint returns HTTP 500. Drupal 8 CMS site without JSON API module enabled.

risks: CC BY-NC 4.0 license — commercial downstream API consumers may violate non-commercial clause
InChIKey not in bulk download files — must compute from SMILES using RDKit or rdkit-stdinchi
Activity values are heterogeneous (numeric with units, qualitative +++/++/+, '>10' bounds) — normalization needed
Multiple delimiter styles: semicolons in Target Symbol, forward-slash in Target ID for multi-target compounds
LYTAC table has many placeholder '.' values for structural components
next_actions: Proceed to plugin generation — primary key strategy: compute InChIKey from SMILES; use TPD ID as fallback; target MyChem.info
